Key points
• Brieﬂy review the epidemiology of lung cancer and non-dietary causes of lung cancer.
• Provide an overview of methodologic challenges in studying the potential inﬂuence of dietary factors on lung cancer risk,
with emphasis on the ubiquitous challenge of confounding by cigarette smoking. Further, epidemiology relies mostly on
evidence from observational studies, and even when randomized trials are possible there are important differences in
research methodology.
• Provide an overview of the evidence of dietary factors that have been widely studied in relation to lung cancer.
